newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 11 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 11 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Monday it qualified for bond insurance the following 11 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Cedar Falls, Iowa, $3.5 million and $4.5 million corporate purpose bonds.
--Royal Oak, Mich., $5.345 million water and sewer bonds, by direct purchase.
--Atwater Independent School District No 2396, Minn., $7.765 million general obligation bonds.
--G.F.W. Public Independent School District No 2635, Minn., $3.295 million GOs.
--Virginia Independent School District No 706, Minn., $6 million GOs.
--Randolph Central School District, N.Y., $2.77 million school district bonds.
--Salmon River Central School District, N.Y., $2.63 million school district bonds.
--Suffolk County Water Authority, N.Y., $37.37 million water revenue bonds, by direct purchase.
--Hewitt, Texas, $1 million tax and revenue certificates.
--Montgomery County, Texas, $4.625 million certificates of obligation.
--Sachse, Texas, $1.14 million tax and revenue certificates.
